name: Marie Elisabeth of Hesse-Darmstadt
contribution: A daughter of Louis VI of Hesse-Darmdstadt and his first wife Maria Elisabeth of Holstein-Gottorp.
image_credit: Peter Schenk the Elder · Public domain

checks.lead: Marie Elisabeth of Hesse-Darmstadt (11 March 1656 – 16 August 1715) was a daughter of Louis VI of Hesse-Darmdstadt and his first wife Maria Elisabeth of Holstein-Gottorp. By her marriage to Henry, Duke of Saxe-Römhild, she was a Duchess consort of Hesse-Darmstadt.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
